author: Seung Wook
problem: Read a string of lowercase letters, '(' and ')'. While possible, delete a contiguous substring that starts with '(' and ends with ')' and has no other parentheses inside; print the string that remains (it does not depend on the order of deletions).
bug_description: The stack stores the index i in the input instead of the current length of the output, so after an earlier deletion a later ')' cuts the output at the wrong place.

comments.accurate: Repeatedly removes innermost parenthesized groups and prints what is left
comments.wrong_behavior: Pushes the input position of each '(' so a matching ')' can cut the output back to where that group began
comments.wrong_location: Stack positions verified; check that unmatched ')' characters are still kept in the output
